title: Field blocks for Thuringia, Germany
description:
For use in the application procedure of the Integrated Administration and Control System (IACS), digital data layers are required that represent the current situation of agricultural use with the required accuracy. The field block is a contiguous agricultural area of one or more farmers surrounded by permanent boundaries. The field block thus contains information on the geographical location of the outer boundaries of the agricultural area. Reference parcels are uniquely numbered throughout Germany (Feldblockident - FBI). They also have a field block size (maximum eligible area) and a land use category.

The following field block types exist:

- Utilized agricultural area (UAA)
- Landscape elements (LE)
- Special use areas (SF)
- Forest areas (FF)

The field blocks are classified separately according to the main land uses of arable land (`AL`), grassland (`GL`), permanent crops (`DA`, `OB`, `WB`), including agroforestry systems with an approved utilization concept and according to the BNK for no "agricultural land" (`NW`, `EF` and `PK`) and others.

Landscape elements (LE) are considered part of the eligible agricultural area under defined conditions. In Thuringia, these permanent conditional features are designated as a separate field block (FB) and are therefore part of the Thuringian area reference system (field block reference). They must have a clear reference to an UAA (agricultural land), i.e. they are located within an arable, permanent grassland or permanent crop area or border directly on it.

To produce the DGK-Lw, (official) orthophotos from the Thuringian Land Registry and Surveying Administration (TLBG) and orthophotos from the TLLLR's own aerial surveys are interpreted. The origin of this image data is 50% of the state area each year, so that up-to-date image data is available for the entire Thuringian state area every year.

This collection holds 1 edition (2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:25832). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_th/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

providers.name: Thüringer Landesamt für Landwirtschaft und Ländlichen Raum

table:columns.name: tk10
table:columns.description: Sheet of the 1:10,000 topographic map covering the centroid of the field block. Example: `51334` (source column `TK10`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: change
table:columns.description: Whether the field block changed since the previous update: `Geaendert` → true, `Unveraendert` → false, `Neu` → null (source column `AENDERUNG`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: flik
table:columns.description: The area identifier (FLIK code) is a 16-character string. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/flik-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: flik_last_year
table:columns.description: FLIK identifier(s) of the previous year, split on `,` (source column `FBI_VJ`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: area_last_year
table:columns.description: Area in the previous year, in ha (source column `FB_FL_VJ`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: bnk
table:columns.description: Category of main land use, short code (source column `BNK`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: afo
table:columns.description: Whether the field block is an agroforestry system (`J` → true, otherwise false) (source column `AFO`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Germany, Thuringia — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/de_th.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.5, 1, 2, 10 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
